domain.name: Embodied / Physical-IoT
domain.description: Software with a physical or spatial footprint — hardware pairing, proximity, ambient presence, or AR overlays on the real world.

governance.name: Budgeted Delegation
governance.description: The agent has a spend/action budget and acts freely inside it, escalating only when it would exceed the cap.
examples: daily grocery auto-reorder under a $50 cap
ad-spend autopilot with a monthly ceiling

latency.name: Interactive (sub-second)
latency.description: Conversational, turn-based UI latency — the user waits for one reply, not a stream of frames.

pitch: A embodied / physical-iot governed by budgeted delegation, operating at interactive (sub-second) latency.
